sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Container build and dev server start
sections.what: Builds a small container image on Node 18 and Alpine Linux, installs the frontend packages, copies in the code, and runs the dev script so the frontend is reachable on port 5173.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets the frontend be started the same way on any machine with Docker.
sections.watch_out: Node 18 is past its end of support, and the dev server is not designed for public use.

summary: Recipe for building a container that runs the frontend development server.
purpose: Lets the frontend run in an isolated container on any machine that has Docker.
why: Likely reason: makes the frontend run the same way on different computers.
how: Starts from Node 18 on Alpine Linux, sets the working folder, copies the package files, installs packages, copies the rest of the code, opens port 5173, and starts the dev script on all network addresses.
inputs: The package.json files and the rest of the frontend code.
outputs: A container image that serves the frontend on port 5173 when started.
risks: Node 18 is past its end of support. The development server is not built for public or production use. Without a .dockerignore file, local folders such as node_modules may be copied into the image.
debug: If the build fails at the install step, check package.json. If the page does not load, confirm the port mapping and that the dev server printed a local address.
